full_sentence: Although the exam was difficult, most students still passed it.
acceptable_variants: many students still passed with good marks.
the class still did well overall.

options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, not cause. A result like 'so every student failed' does not contrast with the difficulty.

options.text: it was held in the morning.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about timing but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.
This describes the setting but does not give the contrasting outcome expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a result that goes against the expectation created by the first part of the sentence.
translation: Хоча іспит був складним, більшість студентів усе ж його склали.
